This is not nuclear language, but it supports a non-reckless escalation posture.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"Marcos: Threat has grown, PH must do more to defend territory","publisher":"GMA News Online / Reuters interview","date":"2024-03-19","url":"https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/topstories/nation/901032/marcos-threat-has-grown-in-south-china-sea-philippines-must-do-more-to-defend-territory/story/owl.video.play.png","summary":"Marcos used firm security language about a growing South China Sea threat, but also said invoking the MDT would not serve a purpose unless the situation became “existential.” That is hawkish, but still bounded and not nuclear brinkmanship.","question_ids":["1B.2","1B.1"]},{"title":"PH not going to war but beefing up AFP vs. external threats","publisher":"Philippine News Agency","date":"2024-06-06","url":"https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1226375","summary":"Marcos backed stronger conventional defense while saying the Philippines was not going to war.
